criteria.cards: Credit/debit card lost, stolen, activation, or PIN reset
criteria.transfers: Wire transfer, ACH, limits, and international payments
criteria.security: Unauthorized access, suspicious login, or compromised credentials
criteria.other: General inquiries, weather, greetings, or non-banking topics

urgency.instructions: Rate how urgent this ticket is
criteria: low: casual inquiry or general information request
medium: normal transaction or delayed transfer request
high: stolen card, active fraud, or compromised account

fraud_alert.instructions: Does this report active fraud, stolen card, or account breach?
